title: rf-plateau-hpo: Adaptive Random Forest n_estimators Tuning with Triplet-Based Plateau Search and Optuna
description:
Reference implementation of triplet-based PLATEAU search for selecting a near-minimal sufficient number of trees (n_estimators, ensemble size) in a Random Forest, integrated with Optuna/TPE hyperparameter optimization.

Instead of sampling n_estimators from a predefined range, the ensemble size is adapted across optimization trials from relative changes of the out-of-bag score at a geometric triplet of forest sizes, under a user-specified relative tolerance. The package also provides fixed-range TPE and Hyperband/BOHB-style baselines, a declarative dataset registry, and the full reproducibility material for the IEEE Access 2026 paper.
